info.title: solmap
info.description: Solmap command-line interface: analyze solutions, serve the graph over MCP, and inspect index status.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Solmap — maps a .NET solution into a queryable code graph.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze a solution and build (or update) its code graph.

options.name: --db
options.description: Path to the Solmap SQLite database. [default: solmap.db]

arguments.name: SOLUTION
arguments.description: Path to the .sln or .csproj to analyze.

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Serve the code graph to MCP clients over stdio.

options.name: --db
options.description: Path to the Solmap SQLite database. [default: solmap.db]

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show what is in the code graph database.

options.name: --db
options.description: Path to the Solmap SQLite database. [default: solmap.db]

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check that the environment can run Solmap (SDK, global.json, MSBuild, graph directory).

options.name: --db
options.description: Path to the Solmap SQLite database. [default: solmap.db]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Directory or solution to check for a governing global.json (defaults to the current directory). [default: <path>]
